༄༅// mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam rnam 'grel 'dab stong 'grol ba'i kha chang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta bcu bzhi pa ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi dgongs pas spyir chig khri drug stong sum brgya gya bzhi/ yang ba'i bya ba bcu bzhi rjes 'brangs bcas/ lci ba nyis 'bum rjes 'brangs bcas/ yang ba bzhi 'bum rjes 'brangs bcas/ phyi mo drug 'bum rjes 'brangs bcas yod pa'i nang gsel/ naṣ+ṭha ra bzhi gzung*/ ud+diṣ+ṭa chig stong chig brgya bdun cu don gcig a dhā 'phred nyer bdun/ steng 'og sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya re bdun pas mdzes pa'i prasta ra'o// ༄༅// bīratsāl+yaḥpatir+herukash+tsopayapradz+nyā.adwalad+yāwabhāsas+yalālit+yasaubhagyam/ swaḥbhumīneyaguh+yatrayāṇāmadhiṣ+ṭhānastuṇakāruṇ+yanītsaṃkhasarbāṇiyenamraḥ ༄༅// brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dang shes rab thabs// gnyis min gnyis su snang ba'i rol pas skal ba can// rang gi go 'phang 'khrid pa'i gsang gsum byin rlabs dang*// thugs rje che myur bla ma mkha' la spyod mar 'dud// 'gro la rjes chags dga' mas byin rlabs dngos grub mchog /rab brnyes grub pa'i dbang phyug nā ro ta pa'i zhabs// de gsung yongs 'dzin pham mthing pa dang shes rab rtse// sgra bsgyur rgyal po blo gros grags pa bcas la 'dud// rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i bcings pa'i don// ji bzhin 'grel la ston pa nyid dang dgongs gcig tu// 'doms pa'i dbang phyug sa skya'i rje btsun rnam lnga dang*// e waṃ yi ge'i dge mtshan 'bar ba'i bka' drin bsams// de dag tshul chen dpyod pa'i bloṃ gros nyi bzhin gsaṃl// gsang chen gdams pa rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i spun zla yongs bzung nas// dpyad gsum dag pas 'doms la rdo rje 'chang dngos dang*// mtshungs las gzhan pa'i dpe med gang der gus phyag 'tshal// rnam par dpyod ldan su zhig blang dor bslab pa'i gnas// zhib mor brtsad cing dris la mdo sngags phyogs kun las// dpyad gsum rnam dag legs par 'doms la ches spro ba'i// yang dag lam ston 'khor lo'i mgon gyis rtag tu srungs// 'di na blo gsal snyan brgyud rgya mtsho yis// legs gsungs mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal bzang*// la gor blta la sngon phyogs smon pa'i lam// skal bzang ngag gi gling bu snyan dgu stsal// rjod byed tshogs gsum rtsig pa'i me long du// brjod bya don bzang 'bod sgrogs mdzes dga'i bzhin// bkrag cher shar ba'i ngo mtshar rnam dpyod kyi// ha nu man+thas mthong don rnam par 'grel// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan skye 'gyur rnams// smon lam stobs kyis 'bras bu mchog ster ba'i// tshul 'di ma shes 'gyod pas legs bris lha// phal cher gnyid kyi go skabs phral lam snyam// mkhas grub bye ba cog gis bshad pa'i lam// dpal ldan sa skya'i thugs bcud gser gyi chos// nyams su len pa'i skal bzang rnal 'byor pa// tshig don ro bde'i sbrang rtsi 'thungs shig kye// zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba'i ngag gis lam yangs par byas nas/

'dir skabs su bab pa ni/ rang re rnams rnyed par dka' ba dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba ni shin tu skal ba bzang ste/ ji skad du/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla med spyad par nus pa yin// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs te dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs nas/ des ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren par byed pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa dang rjes su gnang ba sogs legs par nos nas dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du byed cing*/ rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham pa'i lam zab mo zhig nyams su blangs pas/ gang zag rab tshe 'di'am bar do/ 'bring skye ba bdun/ tha mas kyang dam tshig la nyes pas ma gos na skye ba bcu drug nas mchog gi 'bras bu 'grub par gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab mo re nyams su len pa la 'bad par bya dgos/ de dag kun gyi nang nas kyang rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum/ de dag gi nang nas kyang ches zab pa nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len zab mo don du gnyer zhing sgrub pa lhur len pa'i gang zag gis ngag tu 'don bya mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam zhes bya ba/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis rjes su bzung zhing dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i mkhas grub kyi dbang po tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi mdzad pa gang de don du gnyer ba kun gyis ngag 'don du byed pa yod mod/ de dag gi tshig don zab brling du gyur pa kun gyis go bde ba'i phyir tshig don cung zad 'grel pa la gsum ste/ gang gis rtsom pa'i slob dpon/ des brtsams pa'i smon lam/ smon lam de'i tshig don 'grel ba'o// dang po ni/ gangs can bstan pa'i snang byed chen po dpal sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i rjes 'jug bu dol ngor rdzong tshar gsum sogs bstan 'dzin grags che ba'i mtshan snyan skye ba lnga ba'i dbyangs ltar bsgrags pa mang du byon pa'i nang nas/ 'dir tshar lugs zhes yongs su grags pa'i gtso bo ni tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho zhes mkhas shing grub pa'i yon tan nges par rdo rje 'chang dang mtshungs pa nyid de/ de nyid kyi sku che ba'i yon tan cung zad smos na/ sngon gyi skye ba dang*/ da ltar gyi skye bar che ba'i yon tan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi dpal rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bi ru pa'i rnam 'phrul yin pa dang*/ gnyis pa rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po s+thā bī ra zhes pa dang*/ gsum pa paṇa chen dharma pā la dang*/ bzhi pa paṇa chen gha ya dha ra dang*/ lnga pa mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ drug pa paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa chen po/ bdun pa chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa/ brgyad pa kun mkhyen chos 'od/ dgu pa kun mkhyen bu ston/ bcu pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yar klung pa chen po/ bcu gcig pa pha rgod bsod nams bzang po/ bcu gnyis pa rnal 'byor dbang mo rnams kyi skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul yin pa rje nyid kyi rnam par thar pa rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/

mthu stobs nus pa'i mnga' bdag yab chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang dang*/ yum mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs can bkra shis a mtsho zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sras su skye ba bzhes pa nas brtsams te/ sngon gyi bag chags bzang po sad pa byis pa phal gyi spyod pa las 'das pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar can mang po dang*/ yab chos dpal mgon zhes bya ba stag zhon dang*/ zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa sogs kyi zhal lan mang mthong ba de'i sras su 'khrungs pa/ yig klog nas brtsams te gzhon nu'i bslab bya thams cad brda bstan pa tsam gyis tshegs med du mkhyen pa dang*/ dgung lo bcu bzhir son pa na bdag chen rdo rje 'chang las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang*/ rim gyis thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa las rab tu byung ste/ de dag gi bslab bya rnams la nyes pas ma gos par skyong*/ de nas ring por ma lon par bstan srung gur zhal gyi rnam 'phrul a tsar+ya'i rnam pa gzi brjid can gnyis kyis bsu ba dang bcas te/ kha 'ur rdo rje 'chang kun spangs chos rje'i drung du byon nas lo bdun gyi bar zhabs pad bsten nas gdams pa ma lus pa gsan cing*/ bstan pa'i bdag po nyid du mnga' gsol ba nas brtsams te/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag grags pa rgyal mtshan pa las tshig phyi ma dge slong gi dngos por bsnyen par rdzogs te/ de dag gi bar skabs kun tu mkhas grub kyi bla ma drug cu rtsa gsum tsam la mnga' ba'i phyi rig pa'i gnas dang nang sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi dgongs 'grel bcas pa'i brjod bya sdom pa gsum gyi 'khor du byung ba'i gdams pa'i chos phal cher gsan sbyangs nyams bzhes bsnyen sgrub sogs mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar brjod kyis mi lang mod mdor bstan/ mkhyen brtse'i mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs las/ ji skad du/ mkhas dang grub pa'i yongs 'dzin dbang po mchog /drug cu rtsa gsum gus pas nyer bstan nas// rgya chen gsar rnying rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs// ma lus thugs su chud la gsol ba 'debs// ces dang*/

khyad par nag po chen po'i chos skor man ngag ni/ brgyud ldan bla ma bcu phrag gcig la zhus// 'gran zla kun bral drin can rdo ring pa'i// snyan brgyud zab mo bum pa gang 'byor thob// ces pa ltar thos pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son cing*/ thos don de dag thams cad kyang thugs nyams su bcar bas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma 'khrungs pa sogs ni/ ji skad du/ brjod bral bde chen gnas lugs mngon gyur kyang*// rim gnyis bzlas par bcas pa'i rnal 'byor la// nam yang g.yel med sgrub pa lhur len pa'i// grub pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog la gsol ba 'debs// zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar/ bsgom bzlas la rtse gcig tu gnas pas/ yi dam 'jigs byed rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ bstan srung gur zhal sogs rtag tu sku lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas phrin las thogs med du sgrub pa'i tshul rnams brjod kyis mi lang zhing*/ khyad par skabs su bab pa rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung ba ni/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po'i gsung las kyang*/ chos rje la mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs byas res kyi nged la ltas khyad par can re yong gi 'dug 'bad rtsol mdzad na 'dis mkha' spyod la 'khrid nyan gda'o zhes lung bstan pa ltar khro phur byon pa'i skor lam du gzigs pa dang*/ 'phan yul byon pa'i skabs dang srin po rir bzhugs pa'i skabs rnams su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhi drag gi rnam pas zhal mngon sum bstan cing rjes su bzung ba'i tshul rgyas pa 'og tu 'chad do// gnyis pa des brtsams pa'i mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam zhes bya ba/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong sogs nas/ mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal myur mthong shog /ces pa'i bar gyi legs bshad tshig don rgya che zhing brling ba tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa 'di nyid do// gsum pa smon lam de'i tshig don 'grel pa la klad kyi don dang gzhung gi don gnyis las/

dang po la gsum ste/ ngo bo nges tshig sgra don no// dang po mkha' spyod kyi ngo bo la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ dang po ni mkha' la spyod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya ba yi dam gyi lha'i gzugs can tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar thub pa/ lang tsho lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ longs spyod nam mkha' las 'byung zhing sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku'i zhing khams kun tu rgyu zhing*/ dam pa'i chos nyan nus pa zhig yin par lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad sogs las 'byung ba ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang de rgyas pa 'og tu 'chad do// gnyis pa nges tshig ni/ chos dang 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad nam mkha' las spyod cing rol pa'i don can no// gsum pa sgra don ni/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad du/ kha sar+pa ṇi ste/ mkha' spyod ces pa'i don can no// yang na khe tsa ri zhes pa kha nam mkha' de la gnas bzhi'i rkyen byin pas khe zhes pa la'i don dang*/ tsa ra zhes pa rgyu zhing spyod pa'i don te/ de la dud med kyi rkyen ī byin pas ma zhes pa'i don te/ mkha' la spyod ma zhes pa'i don du'ang sgra bsgyur snga ma rnams kyis de ltar byas pa'ang yod do// gnyis ka ltar yang zhal bzang la/ swā na na zhes pa ste/ nyer bsgyur gyi su sngon du bzhag pa mtshams sbyar ba/ blta ba zhes pa la/ dṛ sha'i lus 'gyur pa sh+ya dang*/ smon lam la nyer bsgyur gyi pra sbon ma'i ṇi dhi dang*/ na ma zhes bya ste/ zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// de'ang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang chos sku spros bral mngon du mdzad kyang*/ sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi mthus gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi sku'i sprul pa mchog sangs rgyas nas/ tha ma gru gzings zam pa sogs kyi bar sku'i rnam pas don mdzad pa ltar/ 'dir yang sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes don dam pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor mar mngon du byas kyang*/

thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir sku'i rnam pa sprul pa du mas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i sgo lta bu ni smon lam nyid yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig ste/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med kyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ste/ bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i go 'phang la 'tsho gzhes su bzhugs pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud la zag med kyi bde ba chen po shar ba dang*/ des rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin pa ni/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems// bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs pa// rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed// ces bshad pa ltar stong pa nyid dang snying rje gnyis dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang gdangs ma 'gags pa'i zlos gar srid pa dang zhi ba'i mig 'phrul ci yang ston pa las/ deng 'dir gdul bya thun mong ma yin pa la/ sbyang gzhi dang*/ sbyong byed dbyer med pa'i rnal 'byor dang mthun pa mkha' spyod dpal mo zhes/ shes rab pha rol phyin ma rang bzhin yid 'phrog rgyal ba ma lus pa skyed pa'i yum gyi rnam pa can gang zhig byang chub bar gyi yi dam du bsgom bzlas kyi rnal 'byor rtse gcig pas brten pa dag 'khyud pa'i rtse dga' ste/ rjes su chags pas bdag rtse dgas skyongs shig ces smon lam mdor bstan du byas pa'o// gnyis pa dbye ba so sor bshad pa la bzhi ste/ pho nya gsum gyi gnas tshul bshad pa/ des lam dang sbyar ba'i tshul/ rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa'i yon tan skye 'gyur smon lam/ smon lam de dag bden pa'i stobs kyis 'grub par byed pa'o// dang po la'ang gsum ste/ lhan skyes kyi mkha' spyod ni/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing de/

de'ang zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam las/ de'ang 'og min gnas su lhan skyes rgyal yum ma// zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ mdo sngags gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i zhing na/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi mgon po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste/ rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku dbye ba// rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*// gzhan ni sprul pa'i sku yin te// dang po gnyis pa'i rten yin no// zhes pas sku 'og ma gnyis kyi rten ngo bo nyid dam rang gzhan nam chos sku rnam grangs su byas pa dang*/ rang don phun sum tshogs pa longs sku dang*/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa sprul sku ste gsum du bzhed de/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po ni mngon rtogs rgyan gyi lung bzhin sku bzhir bzhed mod/ rang lugs brgyad stong 'grel chen du sku gsum du mdzad de/ 'phags pa grol sde sogs kyis kyang sku gsum du bkral zhing*/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang*// de bzhin gzhan pa'i sprul pa ni// chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa// rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag bshad// 'dir sprul pa ni zhes 'byung bas gsum du gnas shing*/ de tshe rnam pa bzhir ni zhes pa chos sku mtshon byed chos la mdzad pa phrin las dang bcas te rnam pa bzhir brjod ces pa'i don yin par mkhas pa dag bzhed pa ni/ spyi rnam las/ pha rol tu phyin pa las ni/ sku gsum dang*/ ye shes bzhi las ma bshad la/ zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pas gsung rab spyi dang bstun na legs pa yin te/ de'ang chos sku spros bral byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa chos kyi sku'i yon tan brgya zhe lnga'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa'i rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid las/ gzhar yang ma g.yos par rnam smin gzugs sku bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan bzang so gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa'i gzugs kyi rnam pa shar ba dang*/

theg pa chen po'i chos kyi longs spyod kyi gzhir gyur pa sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku bye ba khrag khrig bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang la gang 'dul gyi sems can gyi don lhun grub rgyun mi chad du 'byung ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can te/ de dag gi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni theg pa chen po'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams las rgya cher 'byung ba ltar las/ 'dir yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas ma spros so// gnyis pa sngags gzhung gi dgongs pa dang mthun par cung zad bshad na/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan te/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med// snying rje'i yongs gang rgyun mi chad dang 'gog pa med// yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i go 'phang 'di nyid ni// bdag 'dod tshad mas yongs bsgos blo can rnams kyang 'dod// zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang*/ kha sbyor dang*/ bde chen gsum ni longs sku'i yan lag dang*/ rang bzhin med pa ni chos sku'i yan lag dang*/ snying rjes yongs gang dang*/ rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ 'gog pa med pa gsum ni sprul pa'i sku'i yan lag ste/ de'ang 'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyi lam dang mthun pa'i gang zag gi rang snang dang mthun par shar ba'i yon tan gyi bkod pa dang thun mong min pa 'di'i gdul bya'i ngor/ chos sku skye ba med pa las skye ba'i cho 'phrul du snang ba'i rdo rje'i rwa gur ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa ste/ de'ang rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med// bcad par bya dang gzhig med pa// stong nyid rdo rje zhes byar brjod// ces mtshan rtog sgrib pa kun gyis mi phyed pa'i dbyings nyid rdo rje'i rwa gur gyi rnam par shar ba'i nang*/ lus kyi bu ga dang*/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad rnam par dag pa'i gzugs rnam dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi rnam par shar ba dang*/

stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa ste/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi ngo bo/ chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi rnam par shar ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pas sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ byang chub sems kyi myu gu 'phel zhing rgyas pas nyi ma dang*/ stong nyid snying rje gnyis su med pas srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas shing sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pa'i gzugs sku mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar zhing*/ dus gsum dang khams gsum gyi sems can la gzigs pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rnam pa sgrub pa po rang snang du shar ba ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste/ bka' bcu pa nyid nas/ mkha' spyod zhing gi bkod pa ji ltar lags/ zhes dri ba'i lan yang 'dis rdzogs par 'gyur zhing*/ kho bo'i 'dren mchog dam pa rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pas mkha' spyod zhing bkod kyi yi ger stsal ba la yang 'di ltar snang ba dang*/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ yan lag bdun ldan longs sku'i bstod par yang*/ 'dab brgya'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus// pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun pa nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ 'dir yang 'khor la bde mchog yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i gang zag gi rang snang dang*/ chags ldan gdul bya 'dul ba'i gzhan snang gnyis char gyi ngor shar ba ni/ srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i chos sku'i yon tan mtha' dag gzugs rnam du shar ba'i dbus su stobs sogs rgyal ba'i yon tan thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam par shar ba ni kha sbyor gyi yan lag go /gsum pa ni/ thugs rgyud zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos yongs su gang ba'i yon tan gyi bde ba chen po'o// bzhi pa ni/

chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral yang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i rnam kun mchog gi rang bzhin las nam yang 'pho med rtag pa'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa ni rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag go /lnga pa ni/ de ltar chos sku spros bral ngang las ma g.yos par dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad par lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul du 'byung ba ni snying rjes yongs su gang ba'o// drug pa ni/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa de'ang 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad pa'o// bdun pa ni/ srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i phrin las rgyun mi chad pas 'gog pa med pa ste/ de dag la rje ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rjes thog de ma thag par/ chags can skyes bu gdul bar bya ba'i phyir// brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dpal dang*// gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyis rol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che// 'gyur med dga' ba gya nom bla na med// rgyun mi chad pa'i bde ba'i ros gang ma// mkha' spyod bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzes pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma// mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang*// thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus la// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ma// mkha' spyod snying rje'i yongs gang la phyag 'tshal// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas// rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// mkha' spyod rgyun chad med la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rjes gzhan gyi dbang bsgyur nas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas par de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par rab bzhugs pas// mkha' spyod 'gog pa med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sku bzhi yan lag bdun ldan gyi bstod pa'i tshig 'di dag la dpyad pas rtogs par sla ba nyid do// gnyis pa zhing skyes kyi mkha' spyod la ni/

rtsa rgyud las/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni// zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang ni// tshan+do nye ba'i tshan+do dang*// de bzhin 'du ba nye 'du ba// 'thung spyod nye ba'i 'thung spyod dang*// dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod te// 'di rnams sa ni bcu gnyis te// zhes dang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa sogs nas bstan pa'i yul so gnyis/ gnas nyer bzhi yul so bdun du bstan pa rnams ni dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs pa'i gnas te/ de dag tu gnas pa'i ma mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs su gnas pa rnams ni zhing skyes kyi ḍā ki ma ste/ de la'ang phyi'i gnas dang nang gi gnas gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phyi'i gnas ni yul nyer bzhi ste/ de'ang zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam du/ nyer bzhi'i yul na zhing skyes ḍā ki ma// zhes gsungs pa'i don phyi rol 'dzam bu gling gi shar phyogs su pul+li ra ma la ya ste rgyas pa'i ri zhes pa'i don can dang*/ byang du dza lan+dha ra ste drwa ba 'dzin/ nub au ḍā ya na ste 'phur 'gro/ lhor arbu dā ni mchod 'os te de bzhi la lha'i skad du gnas zhes bya'o// shar lhor go da wa ri ni ba'i mchog sbyin/ lho nub ra me shwa ra ste dga' ba'i dbang phyug nub byang du de wī ko ṭi ste lha mo'i mkhar/ byang shar ma la wa phreng ba can te/ de la dri za'i skad du nye ba'i gnas zhes bya'o// shar phyogs kā ma ru pa ste 'dod pa'i gzugs dang*/ byang phyogs o tre ste/ de la gnod sbyin skad du zhing zhes bya'o// nub tri sha ku ne ste gsum dge ba/ lho ko sa la ste mdzod lan/ de la gnod sbyin gyi skad du nye ba'i zhing zhes bya'o// shar lhor ka liṅka ci mtshan nam smra ba'i rtags/ lho nub lam+bā ka ste 'phyang ba can/ de gnyis la srin po'i skad du tshan+do ha zhes bya'o// nub byang kāñtsi te skyur bag can/ byang shar ni ma la ya gangs can ri/ de gnyis la nye ba'i tshan+do zhes bya'o// shar phyogs pre ta pu ri te yi dwags grong khyer dang*/

byang phyogs gṛ ha de wa ste khyim gyi lha/ de la klu'i skad du 'du ba zhes bya'o// nub sau raṣ+ṭa ste yul 'khor bzang po dang*/ lhor su war+ṇa dwī pa ste gser gling ste/ de la nye ba'i 'du ba zhes bya'o// shar lhor nā ga ra ste grong khyer dang*/ lho nub sin+dhū ste chu'i ming can te/ de gnyis la lha min skad du dur khrod ces bya'o// nub byang ma ro'am ma ru ste myang ngam thang ste/ byang shar ku lu ta rigs ldan te/ de la nye ba'i dur khrod ces bya'o// de dag ni phyi rol gyi yul nyer bzhi ste/ de rnams ni gnas la sogs pa bcu gnyis las phye ba'i yul sum cu rtsa gnyis te de dag tu gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams ni ngo bo sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku yin yang*/ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir de dag gi gzugs su bstan pa nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ yul nyer bzhi po de dag tu ma zad/ kye rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ phyi rol na gnas chen sum cu rtsa gnyis su yod par bstan te/ rgyud de nyid las/ ji skad du/ kye bcom ldan 'das/ gnas la sogs pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas ni dzā lan+dha rar bshad// de bzhin du ni au ḍ+yān// gnas ni kol+la gi ri nyid// de bzhin du yang kā ma ru// nye gnas mā la wa zhes brjod// sin+dhū nā ga ra nyid do// zhing ni mum+mu nir bshad de// zhing ni byed pa'i brang nyid do// de wī ko ṭa de bzhin zhing*// zhing ni lcags pa'i brang nyid do// nye zhing ku lu ta zhes brjod// de bzhin arbu dā nyid do// ba yi mchog sbyin kha ba'i ri// nye ba'i zhing ni mdor bsdus pa'o// tshan+do ha ri ke la dang*// lan tshwa rgya mtsho'i nang skyes dang*// lam+ba ka dang kāñtsi nyid// de bzhin sau rāṣ+ṭa nyid do// nye ba'i tshan+do ka liṅka// gser dang ldan pa'i gling dang ni// kaṅka na yang nye tshan+do// mdor bsdus pas ni brjod par bya// 'thung spyod grong khyer gyi dang yang*// 'thung spyod grong gi mthar gnas pa// tsa ri tra dang ko sa la// bin+dh+ya gzhon nu'i grong khyer ro// rdo rje snying po snying rje che// nye ba'i 'thung spyod de nye ba'o// dur khrod rab son dge 'dun dang*// dur khrod rgya mtsho'i 'gram nyid do// skyed tshal rwa ba'i rdzing bu'i 'gram// nye ba'i dur khrod brjod par bya// zhes pas dngos su sum cu rtsa gnyis bstan pa dang*/

gsum pa yul sum cu rtsa bdun du bshad pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ sa paṇ+ḍi tas sdom gsum rab dbye las bstan pa ltar te/ 'di la gong gi so gnyis kyi khar/ 'di la 'dod tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba 'byung yang*/ don la 'di ltar du gnas te/ dbye ba'i gzhi 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba gnyis las/ dbye ba'i ya gyal gnyis gnyis yod pas bzhi dang*/ mi slob pa'i phyi rol gyi gnas 'og min nam/ rdo rje'i gdan gyi gnas gang rung bgrangs pa'i so bdun te/ de'ang 'du ba gnyis po'i dbye ba'i ya gyal bzhi po gang zhe na/ phyag chen thig le las// 'du ba kar+m+ma rā pa ḍa ka dang*/ gser gling gnyis dang*/ nye ba'i 'du ba laṅka na dang 'bigs byed gnyis te bzhir bshad do// bde mchog las ni/ 'du ba pre ta pu ri dang gṛ ha de wa ste gnyis/ nye ba'i 'du ba sau rāṣ+ṭa dang su war+ṇaṇa dwī pa gnyis te bzhir bshad do// de bzhi po'i nang du sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang du bshad zin pa'i ming can 'ga' yod mod kyang*/ zlos pa ni ma yin te/ mi 'don tha dad du shes dgos pa sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad pa ltar shes par bya dgos pa nyid do// des na brtag gnyis nas bshad pa'i gnas so gnyis kyi steng du/ slob lam pa'i dbang du byas na/ bde mchog nas bshad pa lnga ste/ de'ang rwa me shwa ra/ o tre/ tri sha ku ne/ pre ta pu ri/ gṛ ha de wa ste lnga bsnan pas so bdun no// des na zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam gyi dngos su bstan pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i ku lu ta yan gyi nyer bzhi po na bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams ni zhing las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'o// lha so bdun gyi bar bgrang ba'i tshe na yul so bdun du 'gyur ba rnams kyang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi gnas yin pa'i phyir 'phros nas bshad pa'o// gsum pa sngags las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni/ gzhan yang zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam las/

nor 'dzin khyab pa'i karma mu dra ma// zhes pa ni yul dang yul gru rnams na 'khod pa'i bud med ma mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs can rnams ni las las skyes pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'am las kyi phyag rgya ma ste/ de dag kyang phyi rol yul la gnas pa'i zhing skyes yin na'ang 'dir sngags skyes su bsdur btub ste/ spyi dang bye brag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bla mas 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang bskur ba dang byin rlabs kyi dus dang rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyis kyang*/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur byas pa'i skabs kyi/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mar byin gyis brlabs pa rnams ni sngags las skyes pa'o// de ltar na gong gi yul dang yul gru na gnas pa'i bud med mkha' 'gro mar btags pa ba rnams kyang 'dis dbang du byas tshe/ sngags las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma mtshan nyid can du grub pas 'dir bsdu ba legs sam snyam ste/ gzhan du na pho nya bzhir yang 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ khyad par thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo dbang gis smin pa'i gang zag cig gi dbang du byas na/ nang rdo rje'i lus la phyi rol gyi yul de rnams rtsa yi ge'i rnam par tshang ba'i tshul ni/ spyi bo pul+li ra ma la ya/ spyi gtsug dzā lan+dha ra/ rna ba g.yon au ḍ+yān/ ltag pa arbu dā/ rna ba g.yas go dā wa ri/ smin mtshams ra me shwa ra/ mig gnyis de wī ko ṭa/ phrag pa gnyis ma la wa/ mchan khung gnyis kā ma rū pa/ nu ma gnyis o tre/ lte ba tri sha ku ne/ sna rtse ko sa la/ kha ka liṅka/ mgrin pa lam+bā ka snying ga kāñtsi/ mdoms bar ni ma la ya/ mtshan ma pre ta pu ri/ bshang lam gṛ ha de wa/ brla gnyis sau rāṣ+ṭa/ byin pa gnyis bau ṣa ṭa/ sor mo bcu drug na ga ra/ bol gong gnyis sin+dhū/ mthe bong gnyis ma re/ pus mo gnyis ku lu ta ste yul chen nyer bzhi po de dag khams drug gi gang zag cig gi rdo rje'i lus la tshang ba ste/

ji skad du/ pu la sogs pa gang gsungs pa// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// zhes dang*/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// zhes bde dgyes sogs nas yang yang bstan pa ltar te/ zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam las/ rnal 'byor bdag gi skyabs mgon rje btsun ma// khyod ni sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal te// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rnal 'byor bdag zhes pa ni skabs 'dir tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho pa rang nyid de/ gzhan du lam 'di don du gnyer zhing smon lam 'don pa'i rnal 'byor pa gang yin pa la 'jug ste/ de yi bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang sems gsum dbyer med pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni/ 'di nas byang chub snying po mngon du byas pa'i bar gyi skyabs mgon gcig pu bsgrub bya'i gtso bo nyid de/ de'ang rang gi sems nyid ye gdod ma nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa ngo ma shes pa de nyid/ bla mas dbang dang byin rlabs kyi dus su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa ngo sprad/ rang gis kyang yin par ngo shes nas des rgyun skyong ba'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pas 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i thabs su gyur pa gang yin pa ste/ de'ang gzhi dus kyi rang sems 'od gsal stong pa nyid la gzung 'dzin gyi rtog par zhen pa'i dbang gi lus rtsa dang*/ rtsa yi ge dang*/ khams bdud rtsi dang*/ snying po rlung ste de dag grub pa'i lus kyi gnas tshul bstan pa'i rgyud don rnams las rgyas par shes dgos te/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gi ni cho ga yang*// lus kyi de nyid mi shes pas// de dag thams cad 'bras med 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang por lus chags tshul la shin tu mkhas par bya dgos so// gnyis pa phyi nang gi gnas de dag sa lam dang sbyar ba'i tshul ni/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa// de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med// zhing ni 'od byed shes par bya// nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro can// tshan+do mngon du gyur pa ste// nye ba'i tshan+do sbyang dka' ba// 'du ba ring du song ba ste// nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba// dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros nyid// nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin// pha rol phyin bcu'i sa rnams la// zhes pha rol tu phyin pa'i sa bcu dang sbyar nas/

der 'thung spyod dang nye ba'i 'thung spyod gnyis gang dang sbyar gyi gsal kha ma bstan par/ de'i 'grel pa man ngag gi snye mar/ mos spyod dang*/ kun tu 'od kyi sa gnyis dang sbyor bar 'chad kyang*/ dpe med pa'i sa dang*/ ye shes chen po'i sa gnyis dang sbyor dgos pa ni/ rgyud rgyas pa'i lung ku mu tir drangs pa las gsal ba yin no// zhes mkhas pa dag bshad par don la gnas shing*/ de lta bu'i yul de dag dang sa de dag sbyor ba'i go don yang*/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ bdag med stod 'grel las/ ji skad du/ phyi rol na gnas dang nye ba'i gnas la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod la/ ngo bo sangs rgyas yin kyang*/ rnam pa sa dang po la sogs pa thob pa'i tshul bzung ba'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams gnas so// de bzhin du yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi rang gi lus la yang gnas la/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang rjes su mthun pa'i rlung dang*/ byang chub kyi sems gnas pa de rnams dbu mar thim pas/ sa rnams kyi rtog pa skye zhing*/ phyi rol gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams bdag gi grogs su 'gyur ba yin zhes gsungs te/ de'ang rdo rje'i lus la rten dkyil 'khor bzhi ste/ de yang sngar bshad pa'i lus rtsa dang*/ rtsa yi ge dang*/ khams bdud rtsi dang*/ rlung rnams dbu ma'i nang du rim gyis thim pa las sa rnams kyi rtogs pa skye'o// de la yul du du las sa re re'i rtogs pa skyes snyam na/ rgyud las/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni// zhing dang nye ba'i zhing nyid dang*// tshan+do nye ba'i tshan+do nyid// de bzhin 'du ba nye 'du ba// 'thung spyod nye ba'i 'thung spyod nyid// dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod nyid// 'di rnams sa ni bcu gnyis te// sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po nyid// zhes bshad pa yul sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang du byas na/ thog ma'i gnas kyi sa bzhi'i rlung sems dbu mar thim pa las sa dang po'i rtogs pa skye la/

lhag ma'i sa brgyad la yul gnyis gnyis kyi rlung sems thim pas sa re re'i rtogs pa skye zhing*/ mjug tu sa bcu gsum pa la de rnams kyi stobs bsdams pas dbu ma nyid la brten pa sbas pa'i rtsa lngas gtso byas te/ spyi gtsug tu thim pas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rtogs pa skye'o// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// gsum pa de dag rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pa'i yon tan skye 'gyur smon lam la gsum ste/ gang zag rab bzlas bsgom la brten nas 'grub pa'i smon lam/ 'bring bsgom bzlas dang rdzas sbyor la brten nas 'grub pa'i smon lam/ de dag thun mong du dgos pa'i smon lam mo// dang po ni/ 'dis brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi mjug gi smon lam las/ snod kyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal med khang*// bcud kyi sems can baṃ yig rnal 'byor ma// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// cir snang dag pa'i snang bar 'char bar shog /ces gsungs pa ltar/ snod kyi 'jig rten chos 'byung dang*/ bcud kyi sems can rje btsun mar gsal ba/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed/ sbyangs 'bras rnams 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi tshul du lam byed bzhi dang sbyar nas/ ji skad du/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// zhes sogs nas spyod lam rnal 'byor gyi bar te/ de la sngar gyi smon lam de'i rjes su/ de ltar phyogs dang zla ba zhes bshad kyang*/ dus 'khor ri mo'i lugs la brgya dang bcur 'gyur bas cung zad ma legs pas/ de la cung zad bsgyur na/ de ltar bse ru zla ba'i rnal 'byor gyi// nam zhig dus na dga' ma byi ru'i mdog /li khri'i skra grol dmar ser mig g.yo bas// mngon sum rig 'dzin grong du 'khrid par shog /ces 'byung ba ltar/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi bsgom bzlas rkyang pa la brten nas mkha' spyod 'grub pa ni gang zag rab bo// khyad par zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam las/ rdo rje'i grong na e dbyings baṃ gyi dngos// zhes pa'i don ni/

rdo rje'i grong ste lus thabs rgyud kyi lte ba rtsa gsum gyi 'dus mdor/ ma las thob pa'i khams dmar cha rtsa mdud gru gsum pa'i nang rak+ta'i dwangs mas gang ba e yig gi rnam par gnas pa ni/ e dbyings te gru gsum de'i nang khams dmar cha ni/ gzhan du na e dang aṃ sogs bzhed pa/ chos 'di pa'i lugs la baṃ yig gi rnam par gnas pa ni/ nang gi rnam pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pas/ de la gnad du bsnun nas bsgom pas bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes mngon du byed pa'i thabs ni/ rtsa dbu ma kha 'byed pa'i man ngag rlung lus la btsud pas bde ba sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ rlung sems la btsud nas stong pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa sogs bla ma'i man ngag dang khrid gzhung las 'byung ba ltar/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i nyams kyi rim pa rnams rgyud la skyes skyes kyi bar du 'bad pas nyams su len par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de dag gi nyams brtan par gyur nas/ bsgom bzlas de dag gi steng du sin+dhū ras sgrub mchod la brten te sgrub pa ni/ sngar gyi smon lam de'i 'phror/ sin+dhā laṅka li yi sdong bur bcas// ro ldan gnas su bsgrubs shing yul kun tu// nyul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can// 'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /ces dang*/ zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam du/ sgyu ma'i gling na 'jigs rung srin mo dang*// 'dzum dkar g.yo bas lang tsho gsal par ston// zhes gsungs pa'i don khrid yig las 'byung ba ltar/ sgrub bsnyen byas pa'i sin+dhū ra laṅka li'i sdong bur bcug nas/ mtshan mor dur khrod du rgyu zhing kun 'dar gsang ste spyod par bya'o// des nyams brtan par gyur nas/ dpral bar sin+dhū ras dga' ba 'khyil pa bris la 'jig rten 'di blos bor nas/ 'jig rten pa mngon du spyod pa/ ji skad du/ sgyu ma rnams ni thams cad las// bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

bud med mang po 'du ba'i gnas kun tu nyul ba na/ gang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sprul pa yin pa de'i dpral bar sin+dhū ra'i dga' ba 'khyil pa de me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar 'pho 'ong ste/ de yang bud med srin mo'i gzugs can nam/ zhi drag phyed ma'i gzugs can nam/ bud med mdzes ma'i gzugs can lta bu mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa'i gzugs ci yang ston pa 'byung ba de la phyag dang g.yon nas bskor zhing gsol ba btab pas sku dngos su bstan nas mkha' spyod du 'khrid par 'gyur ba de ltar mngon du 'gyur ba smon lam du byas pa'o// yang na tshar chen rdo rje 'chang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung ba'i rtags su byung ba smon lam du byas pa ltar na/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang nyid khro bu byams chen la skor ba mdzad pa'i skor lam na/ bud med gzhon nu nad pa yin zer ba zhig 'dug bskor ba 'ga' byas tsa na de la mche ba je ring je ring yong gi 'dug mig 'khrul ba'am/ krung krung lta bu la bcos nas 'jigs pa ston pa yin nam snyam pa'i tshe/ mthar kha thams cad mche ba skya zang nge ba mtho re lhag pa tsam gyis khengs pa/ dpral ba'i dkyil na khrag gi mig sman tshe lung thang gi rdog po 'dra ba zhig byas har te langs byung bas/ 'di srin mo'am 'ba' mo lta bu zhig yin pa 'dug snyam/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang bcas pas lag tu phreng ba khur nas ded pas skor lam la bros song*/ rjes la bcug phyin pas lho phyogs kyi khyim tshang gi nang zhig tu bros nas sgo de nang nas bcad song*/ de 'phral nang du log gam snyam pa la/ sems theng nge ba 'dra ba zhig byung nas skor ba gsum tsam byas pas/ khang pa de'i steng nas bud med de'i mgo 'dra ba zhig skra zeng nge ba mthong tsam byas/ skad gdangs ngar che ba'i gdangs ma dbyangs la/ dad mos kyi snang ba mi 'dug kyang*// tshe sngon gyi las 'brel gcod thabs med// khrag 'dzag srin po'i ri la phrad// 'phan dkar gyi ljongs su rjes su 'dzin// 'jigs snang log lta ma byed ang*// bde chen longs spyod rnal 'byor pa// zer ba zhig labs byung ba'i mod la/

sngar gyi 'jigs snang de zhig pa 'dra ba'i rig pa had chod de/ lus ljid med pa 'dra ba'i za zi ban bun/ rdog pa gar rgyab mi shes pa/ snang ba 'di gsal la gtad so med pa skad bton la rgyug gam snyam pa zhig byung bas 'di bar chad dam dngos grub gang yin mi shes pa 'dug zhes dang*/ yang de nas mi ring bar/ 'phan yul du phebs pa'i lam zhig tu nam mkha' nas me dpung 'ur sgra dang bcas byung ba ci yin snyam gzigs pas/ chibs sga'i snga ru'i steng bab ma thag rnal 'byor mar byung nas sku la 'khril bas zhag bdun gyi bar zag med kyi bde chen kho na'i ngang du song ba sogs rjes su 'dzin pa'i lam bstan du nges te/ de nyid kyi lam yig tu/ yul ya mtshan khro phu'i gtsug lag sleb// lha byams mgon sku brnyan zhal bzang mthong*// rten khyad par can kun la byin rlabs zhus// ma mi min mkha' 'gros 'jigs gzugs bstan// nga khro rgyal gyi nga rgyal dbyings nas rgyas// mtshon 'phreng lcag gi 'ded drag btang ba'i tshe// khong lung bstan gyi sgra dbyangs sgrog pa skad// khyod ye shes ḍā ki'i lung bstan dang*// mo sha zan gyi mkha' 'gro'i rgyang 'bod gnyis// nga rnal 'byor gyi sems la bde sdug med// gang yin kyang rang ngo dbyings su snyam// a la la rgyal khams bskor ba'i tshe// sngon med kyi ltad mo a re 'jigs// sems nyid kyi rang gdangs yin par go /drin can gyi bla ma de sku drin che// dpal mkha' spyod kyi dga' ma yid 'ong ma// dus ring nas bskyangs pa'i ma ma des// da rig 'dzin gyi grub pa ster ba'i brda// zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ rje tshar chen nyid la rje btsun mas rjes su bzung ba'i brdar/ de ltar byung ba de rjes 'jug rnams la'ang lam gyi rtags de ltar 'byung bar smon lam du byas pa nyid do// de ltar gzigs snang sgyu ma'i gling gi ltad mo de dag mthong ba'i rkyen gyis thugs rgyud la ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams snang gi sgo du ma 'khrungs par gyur pa de lta yang*/

zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam du/ da ni bdag gi ji ltar btsal gyur kyang*// bden par grub pa'i nges pa ma rnyed nas// spros pas dub pa'i sems kyi skyes bu de// brjod bral nags kyi khang bur ngal gso brtan// zhes pa ste/ yi dam gyi byin gyis brlabs pas thugs rgyud la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can 'khrungs pa sems nyid 'od gsal don gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mthong ba ste/ de ltar yang gsol 'debs smon lam du/ yid 'ong rgyal yum phyi yi rnal 'byor ma// baṃ yig nang gi rdo rje btsun mo'i mchog /sems nyid stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum// rang zhal mthong ba'i rtse dgas rol bar shog /zhes rjes 'jug rnams la'ang de ltar 'byung ba smon lam du byas pa'o// gsum pa de dag thun mong du dgos pa'i smon lam ni/ zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam las/ e ma da ni ḍā ki dbyings nas bzhengs// he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las// rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog /bklags pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs// zhes pa'i don ni/ da ni chos sku spros bral gyi ngang las 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyi skur ston cig kye/ zhes lha la bos nas/ bstan nas ci mdzad ce na/ rgyud las/ mkha' 'gro kun gyi snying po ste// 'di ni brjod pa tsam gyis kyang*// dngos grub thams cad skyed byed yin// zhes dang*/ bzlas dang bsgoms pa'i sbyor ba yis// rnam rtog thams cad spangs nas ni// dam tshig mchog gi bzlas pa yis// gsang sngags rgyal po mchog kyang 'grub// zhes bya ba la sogs pa oṃ gsum ma'i sngags 'di ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad thugs gsung sku'i dngos grub thams cad sgrub par byed pa dang*/ khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis thams cad kyi sngags kyi dngos grub sgrub par byed pa'i sngags dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi sgra dbyangs thams cad grag stong skye med kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis rlobs pa'i sngags te/

rje ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis/ oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// dus gsum ngag dang yid kyis rab bzlas pas// srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spong brjod bral gsung*// mkha' spyod gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lan gcig bzlas pa tsam gyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad sngags la brten nas 'grub pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud thams cad dang*/ bstan bcos tshad ma kun las rgya cher gsungs pa'i bden pa des/ dngos grub thams cad da lta nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig ces smon lam du byas pa'o// slar yang sngon gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa sogs mkha' spyod du 'khrid pa ltar/ bdag kyang de ltar du 'gyur ba yang*/ zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam du/ au ḍī ya na'i bas mtha'i nags khrod du// grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa// 'khyud dang tsum+ba'i bde bas rjes skyong nas// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid bzhin bdag kyang skyongs// gaṅgā'i gling du rje btsun ku sa li// mngon sum nam mkha'i dbyings su 'khrid pa dang*// dpal ldan nā ro ta pa rjes bzung ltar// bdag kyang mkha' spyod dga' ma'i grong du khrid// zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ slob dpon 'di nyid bskyed pa'i rim pa dmigs pa'i brten pa thob nas/ rim pa lnga la blo sbyang zhing*/ au ḍī ya na'i nags khrod du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe yul de'i rgyal po skyo bsang dang ri dwags la 'phongs bslab pa'i nags su zhugs pas dge slong de mthong ba na/ gzugs shin tu rid pa/ nyi lhags kyis gdungs pa dang 'tsho ba dman pa mthong nas snying rje skyes te/ 'tsho ba byin gyi grong khyer du 'dong zhes smras pa la/ de na re/ dang po rnams ni yongs su shes pa'i mkhas pa rnams la brnyas par mi bya ste// de ni rtswa rtse chung ngu bas kyang chung ba'i 'byor pas 'khyig pa min// rgyun mi chad pa'i chang 'dzag pa yi 'gram yang nag por song ba yi// glang chen rnams ni pad+ma'i skud pa phra mos 'khyig par mi nus bzhin// zhes gsungs pa la rgyal po ma rang nas/

'di nam zhig sma dbab dgos snyam ste nags gseb kyi btsun pa 'di sus sma dbab nus pa de la bya dga' ster ro// zhes smras pa na/ chang tshong ma zhig gi bu mo mdzes ma pad+ma can gyi rigs su gyur pa des khas blangs nas/ de'i dgos pa'i yo byad rgyal pos sbyar/ bu mo des slob dpon gyi zhabs tog byed pa phul ba gnang ste/ dbang dang dam tshig gi snod rung du byas nas las rgya byas te rim pa lnga sa mthar phyin gyi bar du lo bcu gnyis su sgrub pa mdzad do// de nas de phyogs su gnas pa rnams rdo rje theg pa la bkod/ bdag nyid la mos pa bzlog pa'i ched du grong khyer du bzhud par bzhed nas sprul pa'i bu dang bu mo gnyis shig sprul lo// de nas rgyal po'i chang tshong ma la/ dge slong de khrid de shog ces smras te/ grong khyer gyi skye bo thams cad bsdus nas chang gi bum pa mang po bsgrig tu bcug pa na/ spyan drangs pa na sprul pa'i bu dang bu mo bcas byung ba la/ slob dpon gyi ra'i bshor zhal du bcug pa la/ jo mos chang gi bum pa gtad cing rim pa bzhin blugs nas/ grong khyer du slebs pa'i tshe rgyal po'i dbu byas pa'i grong khyer pa rnams kyis/ sngar slob dpon rang nyid kyis glu blangs pa'i tshig dang*/ sngar rgyal pos spyan drangs pa'i tshe mi 'ong bar chang tshong ma'i bu mos bos pa'i tshe 'bab pa zhes thal mo brdab ste gad mo'i sgra byas pas/ slob dpon gyi ras bshor sa la brdab pas sa rim pa bdun phug ste chu chen po byung*/ rang nyid he ru kar byas/ btsun mo rdo rje rnal 'byor mar byas/ sprul pa'i bu dang bu mo rdo rje dril bur byas te nam mkha' la gshegs nas song ngo*// rgyal po la sogs pa'i skye bo rnams kyis bzod par gsol zhing gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rje chen po la gsol ba thob ces gsungs nas/ thams cad kyis lo ki shwa ra zhes gsol ba btab pas chu'i dbus nas thugs rje chen po'i sku rang byung zhig byung ba la chu rnams skor ba lan bdun byas nas 'og tu song ngo*// thugs rje chen po'i sku de deng sang yang byin rlabs che bar grags shing*/

yang slob dpon nag po spyod pas/ bla ma'i bka' bcag nas spyod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du mdze mo zhig 'dug pas/ mdze mo gcig nga sgrol zer ba la/ 'di khur na mdze 'gos pas dngos grub tshe gcig gis sgrub pa'i bar chad du 'gro snyams nas ma bsgral lo// 'khor ku sa li gcig gis bsgral bas/ ku sa li de he ru kar byas/ mdze mo de rnal 'byor mar byas te mkha' spyod du gshegs pa ltar dang*/ yang nā ro pa ni yul ma ga dha ra 'khrungs pa bram ze'i rigs bcu drug yod pa'i nang nas/ bzang shos nā ro ta pa zhes grags te/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par gyur nas/ bhṛ ka ma la shī lar rab tu byung nas/ mkhas pa sgo drug gi nang nas byang gi sgo srung bar gyur/ slar yang tai lo pa'i drung du dka' ba spyad cing bsten pas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung nas grub pa brnyes shing mkha' spyod du gshegs pa ltar dang*/ bdag sogs kyang mkha' spyod dga' ma'i grong du khrid cig ces smon lam gdab pa ste/ zhes slob dpon de gsum 'dir zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam gyis dngos su bstan pa tsam yin gyi/ der ma zad sa skya pa kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod bdag 'jug gi skabs su mdor bsdus mtshan tsam bshad pa ltar na 'di lta ste/ rgya gar 'phags yul du/ a bha la ka ra sogs 'di'i lam la brten nas grub thob bya khyu 'phur ba ltar byung ba'i tshul dang*/ bod gangs can 'dir yang*/ pu hrang lo tsā bas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod 'grub tshul/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i slob ma bsgom pa mo'i lo rgyus dang*/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la mkha' spyod nas spyan 'dren byung tshul/ na bza' brag phug pa'i nye gnas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon pa'i tshul/ yang na bza' brag phug pa'i slob ma bdun lus ma spangs par song tshul/ grub chen bud+dha pa'i slob ma zhe dgon pa'i dge slong de ba ma ti nyer lnga la mkha' spyod mas spyan drangs tshul/

bla ma dam pa mkha' spyod mas rjes su bzung tshul/ sngags 'chang gzungs pa la rnal 'byor mas byi ru dmar po'i skas dngos su btsugs tshul/ bzang po rgyal mtshan gyi gdung la rnal 'byor ma rang byon 'khrungs tshul/ bla chen chos dpal bas sin+dhū ra'i sgrub pa byas pas khang gshegs dus/ rnal 'byor ma'i sku rang byon 'phel tshul/ khams pa bsod nams bzang po rnal 'byor mas mkha' spyod la dngos su khyer tshul/ shar chen ye rgyal la rnal 'byor mas/ 'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog 'di// mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas su 'khyer// zhes pa'i lung bstan byung ba dang*/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi slob ma tsha ba rong pa shākya rgyal mtshan 'phan yul gyi ri las lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs tshul/ yang tsha ba rong pa bsod nams bzang po tsha rong gi ri las 'chi khar mkha' spyod du gshegs tshul/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i slob ma gsum mkha' spyod du dngos su gshegs pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ paṇa chen gung ru la rnal 'byor mas dngos su rjes su bzung tshul/ chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po la rje btsun mas rak+ta dbu zhwa'i nang du stsal tshul/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang la nang mchod kyi steng du rnal 'byor ma tshon gang pa dngos su byon nas zhal bstan tshul/ srad pa kun blo la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mi'i bu mo dngos kyi rnam par bstan tshul dang*/ khong byang chen du gshegs pa rnal 'byor mas bsu ba'i 'od zer dge ldan pas mthong bas brang brdungs tshul/ rje btsun kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas 'pho ba legs par thebs tshul/ pu hrang rnal 'byor pa rnal 'byor ma la brten nas bar chad bsal tshul dang gdung la rnal 'byor ma byon tshul/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pa la mnal lam du/ rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung tshul/ kun mkhyen rin po che dang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyang rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba la brten nas bde ba can du gshegs tshul/

tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal pa'i bud med kyi tshul sogs rnam sprul du mas mngon sum du zhal bstan tshul sngar smras pa ltar dang*/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang ma'i sku gzugs can de nyid la yang*/ rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma shar dros la bsam gtan phu'i gzims phug tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bsu ba dngos su byon nas de dag dang gsung gleng mdzad pa rje dpon gyis gnam sgo'i steng gi gzims phug gi mdo nas thos tshul/ de nas nyer gcig gi nam langs la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag zab mo 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor gsal 'debs par mdzad de/ phaṭa che ba gnyis dang hig chung ngu zhig gsung ba'i mod la/ de ma thag dbu las chu bskol ba lta bu'i rlangs pa chen po skya bun pa dang bcas/ skad cig nyid la dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga zang thal du gyur pa nas rtsa dbu ma lta bu'i sbom phra snyug ma 'bring po tsam gyis rtsa sbubs stong zhig rgyangs kyis 'thon pa las byang sems nyil le ba dang bcas thogs pa med par mkha' spyod chen po 'og min du gshegs pa'i tshul/ snar thang sde pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pas dge ldan pa'i sku mang po bshig cing sdig bsags kyang*/ gshegs dus rnal 'byor ma la brten nas dbu gtsug 'phar tshul/ bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje'i gdung la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags byon tshul/ sgrub chen pa seng ge grags gshegs dus sin+dhu ra'i char babs tshul/ de la sogs te rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod 'di'i lam la brten nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma thob pa'i lo rgyus mtha' yas pa zhig 'byung bas/ skal bzang rnams 'di'i bzlas bsgom chags med du bgyid cing bsnyen sgrub sogs la 'bad pa dang*/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa bgyid pa'ang skal ba bzang por shes par bya'o// bzhi pa rjes smon lam de dag bden pa'i stobs kyis 'grub par bstan pa ni/

zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam du/ rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// rgyud chen gsang mtha'i zab lam myur ched dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus// mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal myur mthong shog /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum dang*/ 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs nyams khrid lung man ngag gi skor brgyud pa'i bla ma nas/ rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i slob bshad kyi nyams khrid zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blangs pas tshe 'di'am bar do sogs su mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par rgyud gzhung rnams nas nges par bstan pa'i bden pa dang*/ bdag gi gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas bslangs te/ lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams rgyud la skye 'gyur gyi smon lam gang btab pa rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus/ lhag pa'i lha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'dzum zhal te go 'phang mngon du gyur cig pa'o// zhes pa'i don to// de rnams kyis smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa bkra shis rtags kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshig don 'grel pa gang 'tsham zhig bshad zin to// smras pa/ nyi 'od kyis 'khyud byi ru'i 'khri shing mu tig gi /'phyang 'phrul rgyan gyi drwa bas bklubs sam rgyal ba'i yum// 'gro la rjes chags dmar ba'i mdangs 'tsher thod phreng dang*// phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan pa gang yin 'phyang mo nyug /'on te bkod legs dpe yis skye phal mig lam du// blta mdzes tsam las thun mong mchog gi dngos grub dpal// ster ba'i mthu bral gang phyir mngon 'dod dpal de dag /sbyin pa'i dga' mar rtse gcig sgrub la mi brtson su// mkhas dang grub pa'i go sar dbang 'byor phal cher gyis// gshegs pa'i lam chen sdom pa zab mo'i pho nya gsum// gcig tu bsres pa'i lta sgom spyod pas sa lam gyi// yon tan myur skyed dpal ldan sa skya'i gser gyi chos// dbang phyug grangs mnyam rnal 'byor rgyun chags nyams len gyis// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dbyer med rnam dag 'bras bu'i mchog

/bde stong zung 'jug mkha' spyod zhal bzang la blta ba'i// skye 'gyur yon tan smon pa'i lam du sang ba gang*// smon lam rnam 'grel mtshar sdug rkang rtses bsnun pa'i 'phral// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas tshul mya ngan med pa'i 'dab// stong phrag rnam grol ngo mtshar la blta ba'i// rnam par bshad pa'i sgyu rtsal 'phrul 'di kho bos byas// tshul 'dir sgo gsum 'bad pa las byung dge ba'i grus// gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gnas la rab mkhas shing*// sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan nor bu'i sems can gyi// re 'dod skong ba'i chos kyi ded dpon thob gyur cig /de srid skye bar bdag dang don gnyer gyis mtshon pa'i// lus can thams cad dal 'byor bco brgyad rdzogs pa'i rten// thob don bla ma yi dam lha srung mi 'bral bar// phyi nang gtsug lag yongs 'dzin smra ba'i mchog gyur cig /ces tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam rnam 'grel 'dab stong 'grol ba'i kha chang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yi dam 'di'i bsgom bzlas kyi rnal 'byor lhur len pa'i dwangs kya bka' bcu mkhas dbang kun bzang snyan grags rgya mtsho'i gsung gis snga phyir lan mang bskul yang*/ kho bo'i lta byed dbang po la skyon byung ba yar dwangs 'gro ba'i re bas lo shas 'gyang bar slar nan bskul thebs par brten/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung rung gi yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes btags pas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i nang gsel lcags yos kyi bgrang gzhi'i sgrol byed lha mo khrums kyis nya ba'i zhag gi phung po'i tshes dge bar dpal lhun grub steng du sbyar ba sarbar+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// zab don gdams pa'i sbrang rtsi'i thigs pa bzhugs// ༄༅// 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma lhag pa'i lha// tha dad min pa gtsug gi rgyan bzhugs nas// skal ba ldan pa'i don gnyer re bskang phyir// zab don gdams pa 'dri la gnang ba stsol// 'da' dka'i gdams pa nyung 'dus dgos gsungs pa// zab rgyas mang yang sa skya'i gser chos kyi// mkha' la spyod ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams bzhes su// yod snyam de dang mthun pa'i gdams pa ni// lta sgom spyod pa'i tshul 'phros 'di lta ste// 'khor 'das snod bcud snang ba ji snyed pa// rmi lam yul gyi bden med ltad mo ltar// rang sems de der snang las gzhan yod min// sems snang sgyu ma'i rta glang ji bzhin du// snang tsam rang gi ngo bos stong pa ste// mthun rkyen rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i snang ba nyid// rkyen la rag las gang 'das stong par gsungs// de ltar bden gnyis dbyer med brjod bral shes// lta bas srid pa hrul por byed pa'i chos// de yi ngang las bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni// snod kyi 'jig rten ji snyed chos 'byung dmar// phyi nang sgrib med 'ja' 'od gzhal med khang*// nang bcud rang gzhan 'gro drug rnal 'byor ma// snang stong 'ja' lus snang ba lta bur bsgom// rang gzhan bzlas brjod skad rigs thos so cog

/oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags sgra grag tsam// brag cha bzhin du grag stong dbyer med bsgom// sems rtog bzang ngan gang shar shes rab kyis// dpyad pas kha dog dbyibs su ma grub cing*// skye med las skye 'gags med nyams myong yang*// yod med spros dang bral ba'i ngo bo skyong*// de ltar snang grag rig pa 'khor ba'i chos// lha sngags ye shes 'khor lor rnam dag pa'i// nyams len 'di las lhag pa tshe 'di dang*// bar do'i gnas skabs kun tu ga la yod// khyad par 'chi dus dgos pa'i 'pho ba la// da ltar sbyong dang 'chi dus 'pho ba gnyis// dang po sgrub thabs 'brel tshe bsam mi khyab// 'od gsal stong pa'i ngang las rnal 'byor ma// dwangs gsal 'od skur gsal ba'i lte ba'i 'og /sor bzhi tsam nas dbu ma mda' smyug tshad// yar yar je sbom yas sna tshangs bug sgor// rgya mthongs phye ltar yod pa'i spyi bo'i steng*// pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan brdzis pa'i lha// mkha' spyod zhal phyag rgyan rdzogs gsal bar bsgom// de ni rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer med yin// de la mkha' spyod dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// spyan drangs thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus bsam// dbu ma'i mas sna zhabs rdugs gyur pa'i nang*// chos 'byung la gnas rang sems baṃ dmar po// sran rdog tsam zhig yod pa gsal btab nas// longs spyod dge tshogs mchod yon me tog dang*// bdug spos mar me dri bshos rol mor sprul// spyi bo'i bla ma mchod pa'i tshul bsams la// badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da bar gyis lan gcig mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gam gnyis kyis lan gcig bstod/ de la gus pas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag /skyabs gnas bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'di blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la྾

/bdag 'dzin rtsad nas྾ /lam mchog 'pho ba྾ /'phyugs med mkha' spyod྾ /de ltar mos gus drag pos gsol btab mthar// 'og rlung hi zhes 'then pa dang mnyam du// rnam shes ngo bo'i baṃ gyi yi ge de// dbu ma'i lam nas rgya mthongs bya 'phur ltar// tshangs pa'i sgo nas bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i// thugs dang rang sems dbyer med 'dres par bsam// ka zhes 'og rlung slod pa dang mnyam du// baṃ yig mar byung lte 'og gnas par bsam// dmigs pa de 'dra'i ngang dang ma bral bar// hi ka ring po lan grangs bdun tsam brjod// slar yang gsol btab hi ka yang yang brjod// de mthar spyi bo'i bla ma de nyid kyang*// tshangs bug nas zhugs rang gi snying gar bzhugs// de ni rgyun du goms 'dris byed thabs yin// gnyis pa 'chi dus 'pho ba'i las sbyor ni// 'chi bar nges pa rang gis thag chod tshe// gsol ba 'debs pa yan chad sngar bzhin la// 'og rlung hi zhes 'then pa dang mnyam du// rnam shes ngo bo baṃ gyi yi ge de// dbu ma'i lam nas rgya mthongs bya 'phur ltar// tshangs sgo nas thon bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i// thugs kar thim bsam ka zhes brjod pa'i tshe// bla ma yi dam rang sems gsum dbyer med// 'dres pa de yi ngang du cung zad bzhag /slar yang dmigs pa de 'dra'i ngang nyid las// hi ka yang yang brjod pas rnam shes 'pho// skabs rer bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs song snyam pa bya// slar yang spyi bor bla ma bzhugs pa sogs// skad cig gsal gdab yang yang 'pho ba bya// de 'dra dbugs rgyu ma chad bar du bya// des ni mkha' spyod rig 'dzin zhes bya ba// lus ni lo grangs bcu drug lon pa'i nyams// longs spyod nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing*// sangs rgyas sprul sku'i zhing kun thogs med bgrod// dam chos nyan cing lus rten de yi mthar// sangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa gzhung las gsungs// gang tshe 'pho ba gnad du ma song na// spyi bo'i thig le thur bab dkar lam shar// lte ba'i rak+ta gyen log dmar lam 'byung*// de gnyis snying gar 'phrad pas nag lam shar// de mthar 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku yi// zhal mthong de la 'dzin pa ma zhugs par// brjod bral lta ba bskyangs pas 'chi dus kyi// 'od gsal chos sku mngon du 'gyur bar bshad// gal te rkyen gzhan dbang gis 'pho ba nyid// gnad du ma song bar dor 'khyams gyur na// bar do'i snang ba gang shar thams cad kyang*// gong gi sku gsung thugs kyi khyer so gsum// ma 'khrul gsal gdab yang yang dran byas pas// bar dor longs sku 'grub pa gsungs so lags// de skad dgos don gdams ngag snying po 'dis// shes rab gzu bor gnas pas mi bdag gi

/chos srid phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba'i// las byed gang de'i bzhed don kun 'grub shog /zab don gdams pa'i sbrang rtsi'i thigs pa zhig /rnam par dpyod ldan shes rab chos 'phel dang*// dge slong dpal ldan rgyal mtshan zung dag gis// rgyun khyer skabs su bab pa'i dran gsos mchid// gdams pa nyung ngu dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor// ldan phrug tshul khrims rin chen bod pa des// mkhas grub gong ma'i gzhal lung ji bzhin du// go bder ne tso kha yi chos bshad bzhin// lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab che nas bsrings// sarbar+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
